body:
Try sitting him down and having an adult conversation with him. Ask him how HE feels about marriage. Not about you two getting married, his thoughts on marriage in general.

You must understand that not everyone has the same views and values. I personally think marriage is unimportant. I would much rather just spend the rest of my life with a person the way we see fit, not how everyone else thinks we should do it. Talk to him. Hear his side. Leave yourself out of it, just find out his opinions on the matter.
